title: CADV Savannah Lap – Step Up for Peace
summary: A community Savannah lap at Queen’s Park Savannah with adult and child registration, prizes and a commemorative pin.
description: The Coalition Against Domestic Violence’s annual Savannah Lap takes place Saturday 26 September 2026 at 4:30 PM at Queen’s Park Savannah. Participants take part in the Step Up for Peace lap, with prizes advertised and a commemorative pin for all participants. Race Roster lists adult registration at approximately TT$150 plus processing fee and child registration at approximately TT$100 plus processing fee.

places.name: Queen's Park Savannah
